acceptance: make test-docker-exasol passes on a Linux x86-64 CI runner at TPC-H SF 0.01
Image tag is pinned, and the drift/pinning guard plus its required-CI wiring land in the same PR
Compose file never runs under Mocker or on Apple Silicon; docs say so
context:
Item-specific guardrails: never run this stack under Mocker or on Apple Silicon (the image is x86-64 only and privileged). A drift or pinning guard and its required-CI wiring must land in the same PR (AGENTS.md). Keep privileged mode confined to this service.

Shared Exasol guardrails: worktree-only writes with make agent-write-preflight; explicit-path staging, never git add -A; commit identity check, no attribution trailers; uv only; lazy pyexasol import; no credentials in Git, logs, fixtures, or tracker; no live cloud runs; code-skill self-review then make pr-preflight and make pr-open, no auto-merge without make pr-ready; durable artifacts carry no tracker IDs or session narrative; stop and report on failed gates, unverified behavior, license questions, or unapproved host changes.
description:
Give the Exasol adapter automated regression coverage on Linux x86-64 CI using the official `exasol/docker-db` image. That image requires `--privileged` and an x86-64 Linux host, and caps data at 10 GiB raw. It is non-production and not officially supported.

Tasks:
1. `docker/exasol/docker-compose.yml`: pin an exact 2026.x image tag, use privileged mode, set stop_grace_period 120s, remap the host port, and add a healthcheck with an adequate start period. Header comment marks it development/test only, like docker/singlestore/docker-compose.yml.
2. Wire `make test-docker-exasol` through the existing test-docker-% pattern in make/platform-tests.mk, running live_exasol at TPC-H SF 0.01.
3. Add the CI workflow job on ubuntu x86-64 runners only.
4. Add docker_runtime hints for the exasol service and image in benchbox/platforms/base/docker_runtime.py.
5. Update tests/uat/docker_assets.py and its test if they enumerate compose stacks.

Decision gates:
- G1 Start only with explicit user priority.
- G2 If the image needs host sysctl changes (for example the AppArmor userns restriction on Ubuntu 23.10+) that GitHub runners cannot apply, stop and report rather than weakening runner security.
- G3 If CI minutes per run exceed 15 minutes, stop and ask before adding it to required checks.
